mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_sales_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND o.deleted = 0
AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.companyCode} AS BINARY)
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.orderNo}, '%')
AND o.order_type = #{query.orderType} AND (o.customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.customerKeyword}, '%') OR o.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.customerKeyword}, '%')) AND o.status = #{query.status}

SELECT o.* FROM com_sales_order o JOIN com_order_contract_relation r ON r.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND r.order_id = o.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE o.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.contract_id = #{query.contractId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.order_no, o.id

SELECT o.* FROM com_sales_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'ENABLED' AND o.order_type = '0' AND (
(o.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.contractNo} AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.companyCode} AS BINARY))
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_order_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND r.order_id = o.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.contract_id = #{query.contractId} AND r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ) ORDER BY o.order_create_time, o.order_no, o.id
